exercises.explanationUz:
11-12-UNITLAR TESTI - 20 savol.

  2-TUR ShART (If + past, would):
    1 If Sue WON, 5 cities WOULD BE,
    9 If I WERE you, 11 If Bob WOKE
    up, 15 If Lucy DIDN'T EAT
  NISBIY OLMOSh: 3 a place WHERE,
    6 someone WHO, 12 something
    WHICH, 14 something WHICH, 16
    someone WHO, 19 a place WHERE
  SOME / ANY / NO: 2 I've got NO
    money, 7 There is SOME sugar,
    10 SOMEWHERE, 17 NOBODY (kim?
    - hech kim), 18 Has ANYONE
    called? (savol), 20 aren't ANY
    cookies
  PREDLOG: 4 ON the east coast, 8
    IN the heart of, 13 IN the
    south of France

  ⚠ ON the coast, IN the south, IN
  the heart.


⚠ 'LAWN MOWER':

  = maysa o'rgich.

11-12-UNITLAR TAKRORI - 20 ta
  bo'shliq.

  2-TUR ShART GAP: I WOULD prefer;
    What would you do IF you won?;
    We COULD go to the zoo
  NISBIY: went to Rio WHERE he met;
    Do you know ANYONE by the name
    of ...?
  SAYOHAT: boiling HOT; an IDEAL
    place; the lake is CLEAN; look
    FORWARD to; a fantastic VIEW;
    such HEAVY traffic; warm
    SLEEPING bags; How MUCH will
    that be?; tell me your NAME
  ATROF-MUHIT: take CARE of our
    planet; can't live WITHOUT
    water
  Boshqa: does NOTHING but play;
    in the MOOD for; Let's HAVE
    dinner; haven't got ANY /
    ENOUGH flour


⚠ 'BOILING HOT':

  = qaynoq issiq.


⚠ 'IN THE MOOD FOR':

  = ... ga kayfiyati bor.

exercises.explanationUz:
11-12-UNITLAR LUG'ATI VA
  GRAMMATIKASI.

  1 meals INCLUDED in the price
  2 the west COAST of Italy
  3 Venice is LOCATED in
  4 something WHICH opens (narsa)
  5 an ENDANGERED species = yo'qolib
    borayotgan tur
  6 PASS a law = qonun qabul qilmoq
  7 someone WHO looks after (odam)
  8 ACID rain = kislotali yomg'ir
  9 You OUGHT to work less
    ('ought TO' - 'to' bor!)
  10 Car fumes POLLUTE the air


⚠ 'COAST' va 'SHORE':

  coast = qirg'oq (mamlakat
  miqyosida); shore = qirg'oq bo'yi
  (suv yaqini).

exercises.explanationUz:
MEHMONXONA, TAKLIF, MASLAHAT
  DIALOGLARI.

  1 Telefon → How can I HELP YOU?
  2 Taklifni rad etish → I'D LOVE
    TO, but I can't.
  3 Maslahat → If I WERE YOU, I'd
    walk to work.
  4 Taklif → HOW/WHAT ABOUT going
    to the cinema?
  5 Taklif → WHY DON'T WE / SHALL
    WE go to the beach?


⚠ 'IF I WERE YOU':

  = sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam
  ('was' emas, 'WERE').


⚠ 'TO LOSE WEIGHT':

  = ozmoq.

wordFormation.ruleUz: ⚠ SOME / ANY / NO + BODY / THING / WHERE

sentencePatterns.formula: If + EGA + O'TGAN ZAMON, EGA + would + FE'L
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If Sue won the lottery, she would buy a house near the sea.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Syu lotereyada yutganida, dengiz yonidan uy sotib olardi.

sentencePatterns.formula: OT + is + a place where / someone who / something which + ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: A theatre is a place where you can watch a performance. A coach is someone who trains athletes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Teatr - tomosha ko'rish mumkin bo'lgan joy. Murabbiy - sportchilarni mashq qildiradigan odam.

sentencePatterns.formula: JOY + is located / situated + on the coast / in the south / in the heart of
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Boston is located on the east coast. Marseille is situated in the south of France.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Boston sharqiy qirg'oqda joylashgan. Marsel Fransiyaning janubida joylashgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: If + KIM + O'TGAN ZAMON, KIM + would + FE'L
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What would you do if you won £1,000? If I were you, I'd walk to work.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 1000 funt yutsang nima qilarding? Sening o'rningda bo'lsam, ishga piyoda borardim.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: A nurse is someone who looks after sick people. A key is something which opens doors.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hamshira - kasallarga qaraydigan odam. Kalit - eshiklarni ochadigan narsa.

sentencePatterns.formula: How about + -ing? / Why don't we + FE'L? / Shall we + FE'L?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How about going to the cinema on Sunday? - That would be lovely.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yakshanba kinoga borsak-chi? - Juda yaxshi bo'lardi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You ought to work less hours. We should take care of our planet.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kamroq ishlashingiz kerak. Sayyoramizga g'amxo'rlik qilishimiz kerak.
